scope: A curated set of public data sources matching TerraScope, not an exhaustive inventory of the internet.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 L2A via Earth Search
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; preserve source attribution
provides: Scene dates and cloud cover
NDVI, NDRE, NDMI, SAVI and EVI calculated from available bands
Valid-pixel coverage and stress geometry
datasets.limits: Actual field polygon required for indices. Clouded scenes can be unusable. Health scores are experimental derived indicators, not measured yield.

datasets.name: NASA POWER daily meteorology
datasets.resolution: Gridded daily estimates, not an on-farm weather station
datasets.license: NASA POWER data policy and citation guidance
provides: Temperature
Corrected precipitation
Relative humidity
datasets.limits: Coordinates required. Meteorological availability trails by about 2–3 days; fill values are excluded. Weather at a nearby grid cell is not proof of actual irrigation.

datasets.name: Fields of the World — India boundaries
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; attribute original authors and FTW/Kerner Lab
provides: Public sample parcel polygons
Coordinates and boundary-derived area
datasets.limits: Historical benchmark polygons are not the user's farms and are not guaranteed unchanged today. Crop type, current planting/harvest dates and yield are not supplied.

datasets.name: NASA Harvest CropHarvest
datasets.status: Model trained and held-out evaluation published
datasets.coverage: Global agricultural labels from multiple source datasets
datasets.resolution: Labelled points/polygons with associated remote-sensing time series
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for CropHarvest; constituent source terms also apply
provides: Verified labels.geojson downloaded from pinned Zenodo record 10251170
Reproducible local HDF5 feature-manifest training/evaluation pipeline
87,464 official processed HDF5 samples with verified archive MD5 and per-file SHA-256 receipts
Saved crop/non-crop random forest and actual held-out metrics exposed through field dataset API
datasets.limits: 87,464 verified inputs; 3,143 duplicate feature hashes excluded. Trained on 79,220 samples and evaluated on 5,101 held-out source samples: accuracy 75.1813%, F1 0.763718. Global research benchmark linked to existing fields; no field prediction or current farm measurement is claimed.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCereal 2021 v100
datasets.status: Official field AOI acquisition and persistence enabled
provides: Checksum-validated local AOI temporary-crops raster import
Field-polygon historical class areas and coverage
Resumable bounded official ZIP-member acquisition, checksum receipts and immutable field-scoped AOIs
datasets.limits: Historical 2021 classification only. Fields outside their official AEZ raster footprint remain explicitly unavailable. Existing data is preserved; local integration evidence is recorded in docs/reports/pending-dataset-integration.json.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; include ESA WorldCover/Copernicus attribution
provides: Official FlatGeobuf tile index and intersecting S3 raster tile acquisition
Nodata-aware equal-area field clipping, land-cover classes and cropland percent
datasets.limits: Smoke-tested on a test AOI; no farmer-field result persisted. Cropland is not an individual crop type or cadastral boundary.

datasets.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0
datasets.resolution: 250 m native grid; surface 0–5 cm currently requested
provides: WCS AOI coverage for pH, organic carbon, nitrogen and sand/silt/clay
Mean, Q0.05, Q0.95 and uncertainty with source units/scaling
datasets.limits: WCS AOI smoke test succeeded after validating native Homolosine request; no farmer-field result persisted. Modeled estimates do not replace soil tests; the REST API is temporarily paused by ISRIC.

datasets.name: UCSB CHIRPS v3 rainfall
provides: Official daily final-rnl and preliminary-sat selection with missing-day handling
Area-weighted daily mm and monthly totals with revision/source attribution
datasets.limits: 1–2 September 2026 daily rasters verified for a test AOI; no farmer-field result persisted. Separate product, not a drop-in replacement for all NASA weather variables.

datasets.name: FAO Crop Calendar
datasets.status: Clearly labeled Indian demo fallback integrated
datasets.coverage: Selected countries, crops and agroecological zones
provides: Field-scoped validated manual CSV import with source, license, access date and permission reference
Clearly labeled regional recommendations; actual farmer dates are unchanged
Synthetic rice, wheat and maize seasonal windows persisted in PostgreSQL and exposed in API/frontend; reviewed records take priority
datasets.limits: Official API country list excludes India; India endpoint returned HTTP 204. Fallback records are DEMO, not official FAO data. Actual planting and harvest dates are unchanged.
